name: AXM Local Device Handoff Bridge
actions: start a temporary local device handoff
accept an explicit one-time start route from Command Deck or Chroma Studio
pair a phone or tablet by expiring QR link
stop the handoff listener manually or after the final session expires
summary: Start a temporary handoff-only LAN server, pair by expiring QR link and receive only files explicitly selected on the sending device.
notes: The Workshop server remains loopback-only. The LAN sidecar exposes only health, one receive page and bounded upload; it cannot browse a device or the Workshop. Query-driven start is consumed once and never bypasses Mike's device.listen gate.
